1.q: Then Solomon began to build … He prepared
1.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Then Solomon’s workers began to build … They prepared]
This is the name of a mountain.
“Ornan” is the name of a man. “Jebusite” is the name of a people group.

2.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [They began]

2.q: the second day of the second month
2.note: “day 2 of month 2.” This is the second month of the Hebrew calendar. The second day is near the middle of April on Western calendars. (See also: [Ordinal Numbers](ta:translate-ordinal))

3.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [that Solomon’s workers laid]
This word is used here to mark a break in the main story line. Here the narrator begins to explain the dimensions and the design of the temple.
“60 cubits … 20 cubits.” A cubit is 46 centimeters. Alternate translation: [27.6 meters long … 9.2 meters] (See also: [Biblical Distance](ta:translate-bdistance))

4.note: an area of a building made of columns and a roof that leads to and connects with the building’s entrance door. This portico was probably attached to the front part of the wall that surrounded the temple.
A cubit is 46 centimeters. Alternate translation: [9.2 meters]
The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers overlaid]

5.q: He fashioned … which he overlaid … which he carved
5.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers fashioned … which they overlaid … which they carved]
This is a reference to a large room, not a hallway.

6.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers decorated]
Stones that were beautiful, highly valued, and used for decorations.
This is probably the name of a region.

7.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers also overlaid … they carved]
A beam is a long heavy piece of wood used to support a building.

8.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers built … They overlaid]
A cubit is 46 centimeters. Alternate translation: [9.2 meters]
“600 talents.” A talent is 33 kilograms. Alternate translation: [about 20 metric tons] (See also: [Biblical Money](ta:translate-bmoney))

9.note: “50 shekels.” A shekel is 11 grams. Alternate translation: [.55 kilograms] or [about a half a kilogram] (See also: [Biblical Money](ta:translate-bmoney))

10.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers made]

11.note: A cubit is 46 centimeters. Alternate translation: [9.2 meters … 2.3 meters]

13.note: A cubit is 46 centimeters. Alternate translation: [9.2 meters]

14.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers made … they fashioned]
Translate these words as you did in 2 Chronicles 2:7.
Alternate translation: [high quality cloth] or [the best cloth]

15.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [Solomon’s workers also made]
“35 cubits … 5 cubits.” A cubit is 46 centimeters. Alternate translation: [16.1 meters … 2.3 meters] (See also: [Biblical Distance](ta:translate-bdistance))
decorations on top of the pillars

16.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [They made … they also made]

17.note: The readers should understand that Solomon probably commanded other people to do the actual work. Alternate translation: [They set up]

17.q: on the right hand … on the left
17.note: Alternate translation: [on the right side … on the left side] or [on the south side … on the north side]
Possibly a name to describe God as “The One who establishes.”
This name means “in strength” and is possibly used here to describe God because it means, “In Him is strength.”
